name: How long does a typical GEO website audit take?
description: A typical GEO website audit can take 2 to 4 weeks, depending on website size and geographic targets.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical GEO website audit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a GEO website audit varies depending on the website's size, complexity, and the number of geographic targets. Generally, a comprehensive audit for a small to medium-sized business targeting a few cities can take between 2 to 4 weeks. This includes data collection, analysis, report generation, and presentation of findings. Larger websites or those with extensive local presence may require more time.
